toegepas.voor: naby 'n prop, draad of veelprop omval
toegepas.na: naby 'n prop, 'n draad of 'n veelprop omval
toegepas.rede_vinder: Repeat the article in the list, as the block's earlier list does, so the three items read as parallel.
toegepas.fout: The list drops the article after the first item, unlike the parallel list earlier in the same block.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Repeating 'n makes the three items parallel and matches the block's earlier list without changing what is said.

toegepas.voor: Hierdie gevaar begin by hitte en
toegepas.na: Hierdie gevaar begin by hitte, en
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: a comma before 'en' joining two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb ('Hierdie gevaar begin' / ''n verbrande sok kan jou skok').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Required AWS 2017 comma; nothing else changes.

toegepas.blok: Reëls by proppe, sokke en drade
toegepas.voor: Trek 'n prop altyd by die prop self uit
toegepas.na: Trek 'n prop altyd aan die prop self uit
toegepas.rede_vinder: One pulls 'aan' something, which also matches 'nooit aan die draad nie' in the same sentence.
toegepas.fout: 'by die prop self uittrek' sits awkwardly beside 'aan die draad' in the same sentence; one pulls 'aan' something.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Checked the preposition: in both versions you grip and pull the plug itself, not the cord, so the instruction is unchanged and the sentence becomes parallel.

toegepas.blok: Reëls by proppe, sokke en drade
toegepas.voor: en bou op oor baie rukke
toegepas.na: en bou oor baie rukke op
toegepas.rede_vinder: The separable particle 'op' belongs at the end of the clause in Afrikaans.
toegepas.fout: The separable particle 'op' of 'opbou' stands before the adverbial instead of at the end of the clause.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Standard word order for a separable verb; the protected wording 'Daardie skade sit dikwels binne-in' is untouched.

toegepas.blok: Reëls by proppe, sokke en drade
toegepas.voor: of 'n prop wat gekraak is, gebruik nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: The attributive adjective is shorter and more natural and removes the comma inside the list.
toegepas.fout: The relative clause plus comma breaks the parallel with 'n gerafelde draad' and makes 'gebruik nie' read detached.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'n gekraakte prop' says the same thing, is parallel with 'n gerafelde draad', and leaves the instruction itself as it was.

toegepas.voor: Is hy eers van die draad af weg, bly geen elektrisiteit in hom agter nie.
toegepas.na: Sodra hy van die draad af weg is, bly daar geen elektrisiteit in hom agter nie.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The inverted 'Is hy eers ...' condition is literary for Grade 5, and an indefinite subject reads more naturally with 'daar'.
toegepas.fout: The inverted 'Is hy eers ...' condition is literary for Grade 5, and the indefinite subject lacks 'daar'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Sodra ... weg is' and 'bly daar geen' are plain, natural Afrikaans with the same claim; this sentence explains rather than instructs.

na_skrywer.blok: Reëls by proppe, sokke en drade
na_skrywer.voor: 'n Sok wat swartgebrand lyk of warm voel, word nie gebruik nie.
na_skrywer.na: Moenie 'n sok gebruik wat swartgebrand lyk of warm voel nie.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Every other rule in the list is a direct instruction; the passive reads stiff and impersonal for Grade 5.
na_skrywer.fout: The passive 'word nie gebruik nie' reads stiff in a list of direct rules.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: A real weakness, but the proposal recasts a safety instruction from a norm into a command, and the writer owns that wording.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: wys vir hom waar die persoon is
na_skrywer.na: wys vir die grootmens waar die persoon is
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: In this block 'hom' otherwise always means the shocked person, so here it can be misread; name the adult.
na_skrywer.fout: 'hom' in 'wys vir hom' can be read as the shocked person, since 'hom' means him everywhere else in the block.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is real, but this is a who-to-tell safety instruction, and the proposal's 'n grootmens ... die grootmens' repetition is clumsy, so the writer should fix it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Is hy eers van die draad af weg, bly geen elektrisiteit in hom agter nie.
vlae.rede: The opening sentence says the person may be holding 'n draad of 'n toestel, but this sentence names only the wire; whether it should also cover the appliance is a content question for the writer, so it is not changed here.
